title: All Ancestors of a Node in a Directed Acyclic Graph
goal: List every ancestor of each vertex in a directed acyclic graph.
strategy: Process vertices in topological order. Before a vertex leaves the queue, all its ancestors are complete; propagate that set plus the vertex itself along each outgoing edge.

phasePurposes.start: List every ancestor of each vertex in a directed acyclic graph.

phasePurposes.done: List every ancestor of each vertex in a directed acyclic graph.

edgeCases: An edgeless graph has no ancestors
A chain accumulates every earlier vertex
A diamond reaches the same ancestor along two paths only once
